label: Lower Limbs
alt: Interactive anterior view of the left and right lower-limb skeletons, including the pelvic girdles and foot bones
annotationScope: Right hip, knee, ankle, and foot: major bone landmarks plus selected gluteal, iliopsoas, quadriceps, hamstring, triceps surae, tibialis, and fibularis insertions

hotspots.label: Iliac crest (right)
hotspots.description: Superior curved border of the ilium and a palpable pelvic landmark.

hotspots.label: Anterior superior iliac spine (right)
hotspots.description: Anterior end of the iliac crest and a major palpable attachment landmark.

hotspots.label: Anterior inferior iliac spine (right)
hotspots.description: Anterior projection immediately superior to the acetabulum.

hotspots.label: Acetabular rim (right)
hotspots.description: Bony margin of the hip socket surrounding the head of the femur.

hotspots.label: Ischial tuberosity (right)
hotspots.description: Large inferior ischial prominence that bears weight when sitting.

hotspots.label: Neck of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Narrowed region connecting the femoral head to the shaft and trochanters.

hotspots.label: Greater trochanter of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Large lateral projection of the proximal femur and major muscle-attachment site.

hotspots.label: Lesser trochanter of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Posteromedial projection below the femoral neck.

hotspots.label: Anterior facet of greater trochanter
hotspots.description: Insertion on the anterior facet of the greater trochanter.

hotspots.label: Lateral and superoposterior facets of greater trochanter
hotspots.description: Insertion across the lateral and superoposterior facets of the greater trochanter.

hotspots.label: Lesser trochanter
hotspots.description: Common iliacus and psoas major tendon insertion on the lesser trochanter.

hotspots.label: Gluteal tuberosity
hotspots.description: Deep-fiber insertion on the gluteal tuberosity of the posterior femur.

hotspots.label: Medial epicondyle of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Medial distal femoral prominence superior to the medial condyle.

hotspots.label: Lateral epicondyle of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral distal femoral prominence superior to the lateral condyle.

hotspots.label: Medial condyle of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Medial rounded articular surface of the distal femur.

hotspots.label: Lateral condyle of femur (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral rounded articular surface of the distal femur.

hotspots.label: Base of patella (right)
hotspots.description: Broad superior border of the patella within the quadriceps tendon.

hotspots.label: Apex of patella (right)
hotspots.description: Pointed inferior end of the patella that continues into the patellar ligament.

hotspots.label: Lateral condyle of tibia (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral part of the tibial plateau that articulates with the lateral femoral condyle.

hotspots.label: Medial condyle of tibia (right)
hotspots.description: Medial part of the tibial plateau that articulates with the medial femoral condyle.

hotspots.label: Tibial tuberosity (right)
hotspots.description: Anterior proximal tibial prominence that receives the patellar ligament.

hotspots.label: Head of fibula (right)
hotspots.description: Expanded proximal end of the fibula on the lateral side of the knee.

hotspots.label: Base of patella
hotspots.description: Insertion of the quadriceps tendon on the superior patella.

hotspots.label: Pes anserinus on anteromedial proximal tibia
hotspots.description: Shared insertion on the anteromedial proximal tibia, medial to the tibial tuberosity.

hotspots.label: Posterior medial tibial condyle
hotspots.description: Insertion on the posterior surface of the medial tibial condyle.

hotspots.label: Head of fibula
hotspots.description: Insertion on the posterolateral aspect of the fibular head.

hotspots.label: Medial malleolus of tibia (right)
hotspots.description: Distal medial projection of the tibia that forms the medial wall of the ankle mortise.

hotspots.label: Lateral malleolus of fibula (right)
hotspots.description: Distal fibular projection that forms the lateral wall of the ankle mortise.

hotspots.label: Trochlea (dome) of talus (right)
hotspots.description: Superior articular surface of the talus that fits within the tibiofibular ankle mortise.

hotspots.label: Head of talus (right)
hotspots.description: Rounded anterior part of the talus that articulates with the navicular.

hotspots.label: Calcaneal tuberosity (right)
hotspots.description: Large posterior-inferior prominence of the calcaneus that forms the heel.

hotspots.label: Sustentaculum tali (right)
hotspots.description: Medial shelf of the calcaneus that supports the talus.

hotspots.label: Navicular tuberosity (right)
hotspots.description: Medial prominence of the navicular and a key tendon-attachment landmark.

hotspots.label: Tuberosity of fifth metatarsal (right)
hotspots.description: Lateral prominence at the base of the fifth metatarsal.

hotspots.label: Posterior calcaneus via calcaneal tendon
hotspots.description: Shared insertion of gastrocnemius and soleus on the posterior calcaneus through the calcaneal (Achilles) tendon.

hotspots.label: Navicular tuberosity
hotspots.description: Primary insertion on the navicular tuberosity, with expansions to adjacent plantar tarsal structures.

hotspots.label: Medial cuneiform and base of first metatarsal
hotspots.description: Insertion across the medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal.

hotspots.label: Tuberosity at base of fifth metatarsal
hotspots.description: Insertion on the lateral tuberosity at the base of the fifth metatarsal.
